items.source: Abstract base class for testing ChatOptions subclasses.
items.translation: 用于测试ChatOptions子类的抽象基类。

items.source: Return an instance of a builder that should not error when calling ChatOptions.Builder.build().
items.translation: 返回一个构建器实例，调用 ChatOptions.Builder.build() 时不应抛出错误。

items.source: Return an instance of a builder that should not error when calling ChatOptions.Builder.build(). This may mean setting some required fields, depending on the semantics of the particular options class. This convenience method helps reduce repetitive boilerplate code used in each and every test.
items.translation: 返回一个构建器实例，调用ChatOptions.Builder.build()时不应抛出错误。这可能需要设置某些必需字段，具体取决于特定选项类的语义。 此便捷方法有助于减少每个测试中重复使用的样板代码。

items.source: O - the concrete type of ChatOptions
B - the type of the builder for O
items.translation: B - 用于构建 O 的构建器类型
